items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was a fine teacher and pointed me in the right direction... I studied with another fellow for a very short time, a fellow named Cliff Haughton... He helped me a great deal.

ctx.x: This is in the early ’30s, right?

This is the early ’30s, yeah. He was a fine teacher and pointed me in the right direction. Then I studied with another fellow for a very short time, a fellow named Cliff Haughton, whose brother was Chauncey Haughton. He played with Cab Calloway’s band. He was an alto player. They were very well-educated people. He helped me a great deal.
What were you – you were a kid, but were you studying – what kind of music were you playing then? Was it jazz?
